page.overview:
Who is Honey Rays?

Honey Rays is a background Pegasus pony mare with a pink coat, sandy yellow mane and tail, orange eyes, and a cutie mark of two lightning bolts. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.

Honey Rays is identical to Sassaflash, "Shocking Pink", and "Bluebird Happiness" in all but coat and mane color and to "Chocolate Blueberry" in all but tail style and coat and mane color. She shares her design and cutie mark with S04E20 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, her design with "Drizzle", Prim Posy, "Sandstorm", "Blue Diamond", "Snowslide", "Cloud Showers", "Riverdance", "Wind Chill", "Blue Emerald", "Downdraft", "Sky Flower", "Tiger Lily", "Cinnamon Swirl", S02E18 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #3, "Graceful Falls", S04E08 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, S04E13 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #1, and normally "Flower Flight", and her mane and tail style with "Chilly Puddle", "Purple Haze", "Welly", Green Jewel, and S05E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #3.

Honey Rays' only appearance in the series thus far is in Winter Wrap Up. She appears on the weather team of Pegasi led by Rainbow Dash to clear clouds from the sky.

Honey Rays' name is featured on a Cloudsdale High "School Spirit Award" plaque on cover A.
